title: The fixed-point conjecture for the partition complex at elementary abelian subgroups
statement:
Let $\Cwiggle=C_{U\kern-.5pt\left(p^{k}\right)}\left(\Delta_{k}\right)/\left(\Delta_{k}\times S^{1}\right)$, where $C_{U\left(p^k\right)}(\Delta_k)$ is the centralizer of $\Delta_k$ in $U(p^k)$. Let $T\operatorname{GL}_{k}\left(\mathbb{F}_{p}\right)^{\diamond}$ denote the unreduced suspension of the Tits building for $\operatorname{GL}_k(\mathbb{F}_p)$. **Fixed-point conjecture.** There is a homotopy equivalence

$$
\left(\Lcal_{p^{k}}\right)^{\Delta_{k}} \simeq \Cwiggle_{+} \wedge T\operatorname{GL}_{k}\left(\mathbb{F}_{p}\right)^{\diamond}.
$$

This conjecture is a consequence that the authors derive from the branching conjecture, and it is compared with the fixed-point information obtained from theorems on $\Gamma_k$- and $\Delta_k$-fixed points. Its status remains open in the supplied text.
source_name: Gregory Arone and Kathryn Lesh, “Fixed points of coisotropic subgroups of Γ_k on decomposition spaces”, arXiv:1701.06070 (2018).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/1701.06070

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of January 2017).
